item.title: Deploy AWS EC2 Instances with Meshery
item.description:
In this tutorial, you deploy an AWS EC2 instance, and the network it runs in, from Meshery. Meshery manages AWS resources through AWS Controllers for Kubernetes (ACK), which represents each AWS resource as a Kubernetes custom resource. You start from three ready-made designs in the Meshery Catalog, open them in Kanvas, add your AWS credentials, and deploy them in order:

  1. The EC2 controller, which turns EC2 custom resources into real AWS resources.
  2. A VPC and its networking.
  3. The EC2 instances.

Before you begin

  • Meshery, deployed by following the installation guides. This tutorial uses Meshery deployed in a minikube cluster.
  • An AWS account, and an access key for a user that can create VPC and EC2 resources.
  • A Kubernetes cluster, such as minikube or Amazon EKS, connected to Meshery.

The designs create real AWS resources, including a NAT Gateway and an Elastic IP, which AWS bills for. Delete them when you finish.
